fields.v: Review; secondary: Proposes an evaluation method — meta-research review of 325 experiments in 146 peer-reviewed full papers (2025-2026) on agentic coding tools, with described search (DBLP titles and arXiv abstracts, 22 Sep 2026), LLM-based screening and annotation against 21 disclosure questions and five degrees of freedom; derives four requirements for a reference harness and proposes dedicated venue tracks and a planned fractional-factorial experiment on the pi harness

fields.v: No SDD approach. Analytical framework: five degrees of freedom of an experiment (outer harness OH, inner harness IH, model MO, tasks TA, user interaction IN) and 21 disclosure questions (DQs) adapted from the LLM-in-SE guidelines. Proposed reference harness: 11 open-source harnesses assessed (Aider, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, mini-SWE-agent, OpenClaw, opencode, OpenHands, Qwen Code, SWE-agent, Terminus 2, pi); six meet all four requirements; pi (tag v1.0.4) chosen for the planned experiment

fields.v: LLM annotation: Claude Code (Opus 5.5) subagents answered DQs with quotations, a script checked quotations against cited pages and derived the five degree-of-freedom codes deterministically; GPT-6.1-Sol repeated the annotation independently; disagreements resolved by Opus 5.5 and GPT-6.1-Sol judges and the first author. Disagreement 8.5% overall (95% CI [7.5%, 9.5%]), 12.7% for degree-of-freedom codes on 278 experiments found by both models

fields.v: Synthesis: exact versions of all harnesses reported for 15 of 325 experiments; 5 reported experiment dates; 31 shared traces for every attempt. Of 226 experiments comparing harnesses, 191 had at least one contrast changing only the harness, 35 never varied the harness in isolation; 141 changed model or tasks together with the harness; in 115 the model changed with the harness. Of 298 contrasts changing more than one degree of freedom, 111 credited the proposed system as a whole, 7 specifically credited the harness, 118 reported no cause. 40 contrasts changed inner and outer harness together and nothing else
